title: Sprint 1 · Test guide
goal: Patients book a free slot online, set by the therapists' own hours

features.title: Staff sign-in and working hours
features.whats_new: Therapists sign in with a link sent to their email and set the hours they take appointments. Reception can close the clinic on holidays.
features.why: Patients can only book when a therapist really works.
before: Use the staff mailbox at https://mail.staging.clinic.example.com (login in the team vault).
The therapist "Joana Reis" exists, with no working hours yet.

scenarios.title: Sign in with a link
steps: Enter joana@clinic.example.com and choose Send link.
Open the email and choose Sign in.
scenarios.expected: You are signed in and see "Working hours".

scenarios.title: Set Monday morning
steps: In Working hours, set Monday from 9:00 to 13:00.

scenarios.title: Close a day
scenarios.expected: 25 December shows as closed in the calendar.

not_included: Different slot lengths per therapist come later.

features.title: Book an appointment
features.whats_new: Patients book an appointment from their phone: they pick a therapist, a day and a free time, and confirm by email.
features.why: Patients no longer need to call during opening hours.
before: Use a phone, or a browser narrowed to a phone's width.

scenarios.title: Book a free time
steps: Enter your name and the test mailbox address, and choose Book.
Open the confirmation email and choose Confirm.
scenarios.expected: You see "Your appointment is confirmed" for Monday at 10:00.

scenarios.title: A taken time is not offered
steps: Open Joana Reis, next Monday, again.
scenarios.expected: 10:00 is not in the list; the other 7 times are.

scenarios.title: Not confirmed in time
steps: Book 11:00 but do not open the email.
Wait 15 minutes and look at Monday again.

not_included: Cancelling or moving an appointment comes in sprint 2.
Reminders the day before come in sprint 2.
known_issues: The confirmation email can take up to a minute on staging.

verified_automatically: Two patients booking the same time at once: only one booking is kept
